The '''Verdoria system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the creatures known as [[Verdorian fire rat]]s.<ref name="Scarlet" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Verdoria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
